description: I'm Cheick Adam Coulibaly , a 3rd-year Cybersecurity student at BEM Tech in Abidjan. For Field Shift, we want to help Ivorian farmers adapt to climate change using NASA data, through a simple, reliable and secure tool. We're looking for web/mobile devs, data scientists, AI/ML, agronomy or Earth science profiles, and designers. Motivated and curious? Join us!
